# vappcloud_iam_policy (Resource)

A customer-managed VAppCloud IAM policy. Updating `document` creates and activates an immutable policy version.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_iam_policy" "readonly_vmm" {
  name        = "readonly-vmm"
  description = "Allow operators to inspect VMM state"
  document = jsonencode({
    Version = "2026-08-01"
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = ["vmm:Get", "vmm:List"]
      Resource = "*"
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) IAM policy JSON using Version `2026-08-01`. Semantic JSON equality suppresses formatting-only changes.
- `name` (String) Policy name, unique within the organization.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Policy description. Changing it replaces the policy because the API keeps policy metadata immutable.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) Policy ARN.
- `created_at` (String) Creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `default_version` (String) Active immutable policy version.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `managed` (Boolean) Whether the policy is platform-managed. Terraform-created policies are always customer-managed.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp in RFC3339 format.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vappcloud_iam_policy.readonly_vmm policy-id
```
